dataset_spec.name: uci_hcv
dataset_spec.description: UCI HCV laboratory cohort after excluding seven suspect blood-donor observations (608 remaining; four diagnostic categories).
dataset_spec.setting: Laboratory and demographic assessment distinguishing blood donors from hepatitis C disease categories (hepatitis, fibrosis, cirrhosis).

hcv_category.question: Based on the demographic and laboratory findings, which diagnostic category best describes this individual: blood donor, hepatitis, fibrosis, or cirrhosis?
